## Verification

- [ ] The ticket and spec are `APPROVED` or `IMPLEMENTING`.
- [ ] Relevant automated builds and tests pass.
- [ ] Physical-device verification is recorded when automation is insufficient.
- [ ] Behavior changes have tests that do not require committed model weights.
- [ ] No model weights, generated binaries, credentials, private URLs, device identifiers, or confidential research are included.
- [ ] Material AI assistance and non-original sources are disclosed.
- [ ] Public documentation and migration guidance are updated.
- [ ] The spec evidence, `Tickets.md`, and `ROADMAP.md` reflect the new gate.
- [ ] Every commit has a matching DCO sign-off.
